name: Meme Generator
tagline: Meme Generator (memegenerator.net) is one of the original web-based meme creation tools, offering a database of thousands of popular meme templates with a simple caption editor. Its AI-powered features suggest relevant templates for a given topic and can auto-generate captions. With hundreds of millions of memes created on the platform, it's a cultural institution of internet humour.
